svg.title: How the Engineer grows
svg.desc: Animated walkthrough of capability growth in AE. The Engineer starts with the Harness and nothing else. Each verified task leaves a private episode; /consolidate turns episodes into learnings that orient injects into the next task. When a task needs an independent reviewer the catalog lacks, the gap is recorded and, under direct or standing authorization, /create-primitive adds the smallest separate role. A procedure that keeps recurring becomes a durable skill only with verified promotion evidence.
svg.text: How the Engineer grows
orient brings matching learnings into the next task

g.text: Nothing acquired yet: the Engineer and the Harness are a complete setup.
specialist, once the host loads it

svg.text: Day one: one Engineer and the Harness. No skills or specialists are acquired yet.
Task 1 arrives. The Engineer delivers it through the Harness gates.
Checks pass on the final bytes, so the task is verified.
If the task taught something, the Engineer records a private episode. It stays on your machine.
/consolidate turns episodes into learnings. Only ae commands write that store.
Task 2 arrives.
Orient brings the learnings that match it into the task context.
The task needs an independent security reviewer the catalog does not have.
Acquisition needs your direct authorization or a standing grant that covers it.
/create-primitive adds the smallest separate role. It is used only once the host has loaded it.
With the new reviewer available, Task 2 is reviewed independently and verified.
Another episode, another learning. Knowledge compounds from verified work.
Task 3 repeats a procedure that earlier tasks needed too.
A repeated procedure becomes a durable skill only with verified promotion evidence.
Creating it still needs authority that covers it.
It starts as a candidate and becomes active only after its trigger and outcome evals pass.
The Engineer grows from proven work, within the authority you granted.
Verified work leaves episodes, episodes become learnings, and gaps become skills or specialists, within the authority you grant.
